newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Amuay cat cracker to re-start this week.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Amuay cat cracker to re-start this week.

text.p: Repairs on a catalytic cracker unit at Venezuela's 510,000-barrels per day (bpd) Amuay refinery are completed and normal production is expected to resume this week, a spokesman for PDVSA affiliate Lagoven said on Monday.
"We have started cargo tests but we still don't have an exact date as to when commercial operations will resume but we estimate it could be around mid-week," the spokesman told Reuters.
The 108,000-bpd unit, which is used to produce gasoline, went down on October 20 when an air compressor failed.
Exports contracts during the stoppage have been met from inventories at Amuay and near-by Cardon and Curacao Isla refineries.
Venezuela is the major foreign gasoline supplier to the United States, shipping some 48,000 bpd over the first half of this year, according to U.S. Departement of Energy figures.
